headline: China may be running a large unannounced exercise simulating Taiwan's isolation.

items.text: AEI/ISW report China may be running an unannounced exercise simulating the isolation of Taiwan, larger than Justice Mission 2025.
Taiwan's NSC chief says more than 100 Chinese navy and coast guard vessels are operating in the western Pacific.

action: Top up and rotate water, food and batteries; no urgent steps needed.

headline: Baseline assessment: about 1–5% chance of a 3+ day cyber blackout in Sydney over 10 years.

items.text: No country has had a confirmed multi-day cyber-caused blackout; Ukraine 2015/16 outages lasted 1–6 hours.
ASIO said in Nov 2025 that Chinese state hackers were probing Australian power, water and transport networks.

action: Build up to 7 days of supplies.
